director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
pata nahi
Aaj hum scale se lambai naapenge, metre aur centimetre mein. Toh shuru karte hain?
pata nahi, aap batao

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Cricket bat ka handle bhi scale se naapte hain. Aaj dekhenge, naapna kahan se shuru hota hai. Scale par 0 se 1, 1 se 2, har khaana 1 centimetre ka hai. Pencil 0 se 7 tak rakhi hai: 7 khaane, toh 7 centimetre. Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: pata nahi
Crayon ke neeche wale khaane ek-ek karke gino, 3 wale nishaan se shuru karke. 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak rakhe crayon ki lambai kitni hai?
director.card: Ab ek crayon 3 ke nishaan se 9 ke nishaan tak hai. Crayon kitna lamba hai?

director.text: hindi mein batao na
Achha, ab Hindi mein kehti hoon. 3 se 9 tak ke khaane gino. Crayon kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: 3 se 9 tak ke khaane gino. Crayon kitne centimetre ka hai?

Bilkul sahi: 3 se 9 tak 1-1 centimetre ke 6 khaane hain, yaani 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Scale ka pehla khaana 0 aur 1 ke beech hota hai. Jo cheez 1 se shuru hoti hai, uske neeche woh pehla khaana aata hi nahi. Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: pata nahi, aap batao
Patte ke neeche ka pehla khaana 1 aur 2 ke beech wala hai. Wahan se aakhri sire tak khaane gino. 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak rakha patta kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Ek patta scale par 1 ke nishaan se 8 ke nishaan tak hai. Patta kitna lamba hai?

director.text: 7 centimetre

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 8 − 1, yaani 7 centimetre. Golu ka scale toot gaya, ab woh 4 se shuru hota hai. Uske khaane bhi 1-1 centimetre ke hain: cheez jahan se shuru ho, wahin se khaane gino. Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: screen par dikhao na
4 ke nishaan se shuru karke ek-ek khaana gino, jab tak 8 khaane poore na ho jaayein. Ab tum batao, main sun rahi hoon.
director.card: Golu ki pencil 8 centimetre lambi hai. Woh uska ek sira 4 ke nishaan par rakhta hai. Doosra sira kis nishaan par aayega?

director.text: barah

Bilkul sahi. 4 se aage 8 khaane chalo toh 12 aata hai: 4 + 8 = 12. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge. Golu ka toota scale 4 ke nishaan se shuru hota hai. Uspar ek tehni 5 ke nishaan se 12 ke nishaan tak rakhi hai. Tehni ki lambai nikaalni hai. Tehni ki lambai ke liye 12 mein se kaunsa nishaan ghataoge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum saath mein karenge.

director.text: Yeh jawab nahi hai. Tehni 5 se shuru hoti hai, scale ke 4 se nahi. Isliye 12 mein se 5 ghatayenge. Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: mujhe nahi pata
Tehni ke ek sire se doosre sire tak ke khaane ek-ek karke gino. Toote scale par 5 se 12 tak rakhi tehni kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: tehni kitni lambi hai?

director.text: saat

Haan, bilkul theek: tehni 5 se 12 tak hai, aur 12 − 5 = 7, jo 5 se 12 tak ke khaanon ki ginti hai. Toh poora jawab: tehni 7 centimetre lambi hai. Chalo, ab tumhari apni baari. Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?
director.card: Scale par rakhe rubber ka ek sira 5 par hai, doosra 9 par. Rubber kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: 9 cm

9 cm sahi nahi hai. Ise doosri tarah samajhte hain. Nishaan nahi, khaane gino. 2 se 5 tak teen khaane hain: 2 se 3, 3 se 4, aur 4 se 5. Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 10 cm
Nahi, 10 cm theek nahi. 10 par chabi rukti hai, par shuru 6 par hoti hai; pehle wale khaane chabi mein nahi aate. Toote scale par 6 se 10 tak rakhi chabi kitne centimetre ki hai?
director.card: Toote scale par chabi ka shuru 6 par hai, aur ant 10 par. Chabi kitni lambi hai?

director.text: 10 cm
10 cm se baat nahi bani. Chabi ke neeche wale khaane 6 ke nishaan se ginna shuru karo. Apna jawab bolo, jaisa bhi lage.

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 4 cm hai, kyunki rubber 5 se 9 tak rakha hai; uske neeche 9 − 5 = 4 khaane, yaani 4 centimetre. Yahan tak theek hai?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara

Koi baat nahi, chalo aage badhte hain. Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, yeh naap le lene ke baad. Chalo, pehle yahan se aage badhte hain. Laal crayon 0 se 7 tak hai, aur neela crayon 3 se 9 tak. Kaunsa crayon lamba hai, laal ya neela?

director.text: laal
Bilkul sahi. Laal 0 se 7 tak hai, toh 7 centimetre; neela 3 se 9 tak, toh 9 − 3 = 6 centimetre. Cricket mein kya kuch aisa hai jise tum naap sakte ho?
jab Virat chauka maarta hai, woh
Arre, chauka! Achha hua tumne bataya. Theek hai, ab phir se apne kaam par lagte hain. Bat ka grip ek aur toote scale se naapa: grip 6 se shuru hokar 15 par khatam hota hai. Grip kitna lamba hai?

director.text: nau cm

Haan, bilkul theek: grip 6 se 15 tak hai: 15 − 6 = 9 khaane, toh 9 centimetre. Chhoti cheezein centimetre mein naapte hain. Ab dekhenge ki lambi cheezon ke liye metre kya hai, aur ek metre mein kitne centimetre. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
mujhe nahi pata
Ab metre ki baari hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
haan

Yeh ek metre ki lakdi hai. Ispar 0 se 100 tak centimetre likhe hain: 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100. Toh 1 metre mein 100 centimetre hote hain. Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: 70 cm
70 cm sahi nahi hai. 70 toh bat ki apni lambai hai; poocha yeh hai ki bat ke upar se metre ke aakhri nishaan tak kitna bacha. 70 ke nishaan tak aane wala bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?
director.card: Ek cricket bat is lakdi ke saath khada kiya, toh woh 0 se 70 ke nishaan tak aaya. Bat ek metre se kitne centimetre chhota hai?

director.text: 30 centimetre chhota hai

Bilkul sahi, kyunki bat ke upar 70 se 100 tak 30 centimetre bacha. Yeh lamba feeta hai, jis par sirf 10-10 centimetre ke nishaan hain. Jahan metre ka number likha hai, wahan poora metre hota hai; do numberon ke beech das chhote khaane. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?
director.card: Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

director.text: 1 metre 4 cm

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Ek aur tareeka dekhte hain. Ek metre 10 centimetre nahi, poore 100 centimetre ka hai. Feete ka ek chhota khaana 10 centimetre hai; uske baad 90 centimetre aur aate hain, tab metre poora hota hai. Yeh hissa saaf hua?
pata nahi

Lakdi par 10-10 centimetre aage badho: 10, 20, 30, aur aise hi 100 tak. Das baar badhne par ek metre poora hota hai. Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?

director.card: Mez ki lambai feete par 0 se is nishaan tak hai. Metre aur centimetre mein, mez kitni lambi hui?

Haan, bilkul theek. 1 metre ke baad mez 3 chhote khaane aur jaati hai; 3 baar 10 yaani 30, kul 1 metre 30 centimetre. Chalo, pehle wale sawaal ki taraf wapas aate hain. Ek parda feete par 0 se is nishaan tak aata hai. Parda kitna lamba hai, metre aur centimetre mein?

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is feete ke khaane scale jaise 1-1 centimetre ke nahi hain; yahan ek metre ke poore 100 centimetre bas das khaanon mein bante hain. Feete par 0 se is nishaan tak wala parda kitne metre aur kitne centimetre ka hai?

director.text: 1 m 40 cm

Bilkul sahi: parda 1 metre wale nishaan se 4 chhote khaane aage hai, har ek 10 centimetre, toh 1 metre 40 centimetre. 1 metre 5 centimetre ka matlab: ek poora metre, yaani 100 centimetre, aur 5 centimetre aur. Toh 105 centimetre. Ek ribbon 2 metre 8 centimetre lambi hai. Ribbon kitne centimetre ki hai?

director.text: 208 cm

Sahi jawab, kyunki 2 metre = 200 centimetre, aur 200 + 8 = 208 centimetre. Chalo, ab ek sawaal hum dono saath mein karte hain. Ek rassi 3 metre lambi hai. Usmein se 40 centimetre kaat diya. Kitni rassi bachi, metre aur centimetre mein? 40 centimetre ghatane se pehle 3 metre ka kya karoge?

Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
